# access.Role

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A custom role of an organization: a named set of tenant permissions.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.Role` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.role.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the role was created (UTC). |  |
| `description` | yes | `none` | What the role is for; may be empty. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Automatic id of the custom role. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Display name of the role. |  |
| `permissions` | yes | `none` | Tenant permissions the role grants. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization that owns the role. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the role last changed (UTC). |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
